main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise. A championship-standard 2,200m oval featuring wide, sweeping turns and a demanding 420m home straight with a steady 3-metre uphill rise toward the winning post. Modeled directly after Royal Randwick, the spacious layout and uphill stretch provide a fair contest that heavily rewards big-striding gallopers and strong-finishing closers ('Swoopers').
main_turf.post_bias: Fair from almost all starting points when the rail is True. In 1000m-1200m sprints, middle draws (3-7) offer optimal positioning. In 1400m-1600m races, the long backstretch run allows wide draws time to find cover, though saving ground on the sweeping home turn is essential for the 420m climb.

handicapping_angles.the_randwick_replica_effect: Sydney metropolitan trainers (Waller, Waterhouse/Bott, Maher, Baker) target Kembla Grange for big-striding horses unsuited to tighter provincial tracks (like Wyong or Gosford). Heavily upgrade horses shipping down from Sydney with strong L400m closing splits.
handicapping_angles.uphill_420m_stamina_test: The 3m rise over the 420m home straight wears down pure 'Need-the-Lead' sprinters. Ensure front-runners have proven stamina over today's distance; otherwise, upgrade mid-pack stalkers and swoopers.
handicapping_angles.sydney_midway_and_provincial_class_spike: Local provincial form often struggles against class-dropping city maidens or horses coming off Sydney 'Midway' benchmarks. Give a distinct class rating boost to runners exiting Rosehill, Randwick, or Warwick Farm midweek company.
handicapping_angles.rail_placement_bias_shift: When the rail is in the True position, Kembla plays exceptionally fair. When the rail is moved out +6m or further, the wide turns narrow significantly, creating an aggressive 'On-Pace / Rail' bias.
handicapping_angles.australian_weight_bifurcation: In NSW Provincial Benchmark races (BM64-BM78), top weights carrying 59kg+ face a strict penalty (1kg = ~1 length over 420m uphill). In feature events (The Gong, Keith F Nolan / Kembla Grange Classic), ignore minor weight spreads and prioritize peak class and rated form.
